test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : OJR :: QLT : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : OJR :: QLT : %

Option 1) # = NIQ, % = RMU → NIQ : OJR :: QLT : RMU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7734943b12877e5a88337d07b1c37ffd6f049b41179c7f8120e8c707f1771bd.png] 

Option 2) # = NIQ, % = RNU → NIQ : OJR :: QLT : RNU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76ff275543b202c3101605eed5cf41144cc1437c0a0caa8d4790ad8836a70667.png] 

Option 3) # = NIQ, % = RMV → NIQ : OJR :: QLT : RMV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/663ae2122ac22109017b76d315a3d43d06de1f45a7bda955fe6055bc4d559f15.png] 

Option 4) # = NIR, % = RMU → NIR : OJR :: QLT : RMU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3924a0bfd693cca2ba0f7ac5bfd58befa7a022bc62bbbdc527c880bf21cd3e79.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
